title: DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, July 25, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Thursday, July 25, 2018 Posted by admin on July 26th, (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT) up +58 points.
Wednesday the Dow was up +172.16 (+0.68%) at 25,414.10.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.81%.
There were 25 Dow stocks up Wednesday.
The Dow stock winners Wednesday were led by Microsoft (MSFT) +2.94% and Nike (NKE) +2.16%.
The Dow stock losers Wednesday were led by Verizon (VZ) -1.16% and Boeing (BA) -0.66%.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended lower.
